headline: Visa CLI lets people verify an AI agent with a Visa card
body: Visa launched a new version of Visa CLI, an agent wallet, and Cuy Sheffield, head of Visa Crypto Labs, said in a Sunday post on X. Sheffield said Visa's 5 billion payment credentials are well-suited to verify that an agent is authorized by an accountable individual. The new version is available to users in the United States with eligible Visa cards.
note: Using a card to show who stands behind an agent could put card issuers into agent verification, if this model spreads beyond Visa's own product.

evidence.text: Visa launched a new version of its artificial intelligence agent wallet , Visa CLI , Cuy Sheffield , head of Visa Crypto Labs, said in a Sunday (Nov. 22) post on social platform X.
The new version of Visa CLI is available to users in the United States with eligible Visa cards, according to the post.
Visa can support that confidence with its 5 billion Visa payment credentials that connect consumers and businesses with merchants and financial institutions, Sheffield said in the article.

“We believe that these 5B existing credentials are well-suited to be used by consumers and businesses to verify that an agent is authorized by an accountable individual,” Sheffield said in the article.
Visa CLI is “an agent wallet that lets people verify their agent with a Visa card, then work with it to earn OUSD by completing creative tasks,” Sheffield said in the post.
